item.title: Emotional Wisdom Rooted in Science and Contemplative Practice
item.description: Discover how the CEB Teacher Training blends emotion science from Paul Ekman with contemplative practices to deepen awareness, resilience, and compassion.

item.title: Facial Expressions and Emotional Awareness: Why Context Matters
item.description: Discover the importance of context in reading facial expressions, emotional signals, and nonverbal cues for better communication.

item.title: No Bad Emotions
item.description: This article redefines our understanding of emotions, explaining why there are no "bad" feelings. Learn how every emotion, from frustration to joy, provides essential information for survival, growth, and well-being.

item.title: Jetzt verfügbar auf Deutsch, Französisch und Italienisch: Online-Trainings für Mikroexpressionen
item.description: Wir freuen uns, Ihnen mitteilen zu können, dass die Werkzeuge der Paul Ekman Group für das Online-Training zur Erkennung von Mikroausdrücken jetzt auf Deutsch, Französisch und Italienisch verfügbar sind – und damit unsere wissenschaftlich fundierte Emotionsschulung so zugänglich wie nie zuvor ist!

item.title: Maintenant disponibles en français, italien et allemand : outils de formation en ligne sur les micro-expressions
item.description: Nous sommes ravis d’annoncer que les outils de formation en ligne du Paul Ekman Group sur les micro-expressions sont désormais disponibles en français, italien et allemand, rendant notre approche scientifique de la formation émotionnelle en ligne plus accessible que jamais!

item.title: Da ora disponibili in italiano, francese e tedesco: strumenti di formazione online sulle microespressioni facciali
item.description: Siamo entusiasti di condividere con voi gli strumenti di formazione online elaborati da Paul Ekman Group sulle microespressioni facciali ora disponibili in italiano, francese e tedesco – rendendo la nostra formazione online formulata sulla scienza delle emozioni più accessibile che mai!

item.title: Now Available in Italian, French, and German: Online Micro Expression Training Tools
item.description: We're proud to announce that our micro expression and deception detection training tools are now fully translated into Italian, French, and German, in addition to English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

item.title: The Passing of Dr. Paul Ekman
item.description: Dr. Paul Ekman, pioneer of emotion science and creator of FACS, has passed away at 91. Read his memorial and share reflections on his life and legacy.

item.title: Paul Ekman's Legacy: Eve Ekman Reflects on His Life, Work, and Compassion
item.description: Eve Ekman reflects on the life and legacy of her father, renowned emotions researcher Paul Ekman: exploring his scientific contributions, personal transformation, and lifelong commitment to reducing human suffering.

item.title: The Link Between Emotion, Facial Expression, and Cardiovascular Health
item.description: Explore Paul Ekman’s legacy in health psychology, focusing on his research with Dr. Erika Rosenberg regarding the connection between emotion, facial expressions and heart health.
